name: Acumens Defective Inventory Management
brief: Acumens Defective Inventory Management is an app designed to embed inspection processes into inventory management within Business Central. This feature enforces structured quality inspections, record critical metrics, and ensures production and manufacturing processes meet compliance and performance standards.
